title: 부가가치세법 제26조 제1항 제2호 (Value-Added Tax Act art. 26(1)2), with Basic Ruling 26-0-1
archive_note: PARTIAL. law.go.kr disallows automated access. The article and the basic ruling are recorded as quoted verbatim in a National Tax Service reply and several professional commentaries — identical across sources, which corroborates the text without being a capture of the statute.
establishes: The supply of tap water is exempt from Korean VAT under art. 26(1)2
Basic Ruling 26-0-1 defines tap water as water supplied through conduits by a water supplier under the Water Supply Act — which is what makes the exemption attach to Seoul Arisu
That the exemption attaches to the statutory supplier: a non-supplier selling tap water on its own account is chargeable
does_not_establish: The treatment of 하수도 사용료. Art. 26(1)2 names tap water and not sewerage. A sewerage use charge is levied by a local authority under the Sewerage Act rather than supplied by a business, which is a different question and is not answered here.
The treatment of 물이용부담금, a statutory levy rather than consideration for a supply. Almost certainly outside VAT for that reason, and almost certainly is not a source.
